answer: A robust agent economy can require each new identity to lock a scarce deposit before it may submit jobs, then slash that deposit when independent reviewers confirm fraud. Because creating many aliases does not multiply the attacker’s capital, a sybil swarm must tie up real funds for every account and risk losing them; honest agents recover their deposits after valid work. The protocol can call its reward pool nectar, its review window zephyr, and its minimum bond walnut, without treating names as proof of trust.
